A town has 15,600 adults. A researcher contacted a random sample of 400 of these adults and asked whether they would use a proposed evening bus service. Of the adults contacted, 75 declined to answer. Of those who answered, 104 said yes and the rest said no. Assume that the adults who answered are representative of all adults in the town. Based on the survey, approximately how many more adults in the town would answer no than would answer yes?

Last week, the chess club members volunteered a mean of 5.8 hours, the robotics club members volunteered a mean of 8.25 hours, and the 4 students who belong to both clubs volunteered a mean of 9.5 hours. (A student in both clubs has his or her hours included in the data of both clubs.) How much greater is the mean number of hours for the students who are in the robotics club only than the mean number of hours for the students who are in the chess club only, to the nearest hundredth?

Today, before the first weekly change, both of them receive a one-time gift of $60, which they deposit. After how many weeks will Priya's balance be exactly 3 times Marcus's balance?

A store sells a lamp for $40. The lamp costs the store $25, and the store also pays a salesperson a commission on the sale of a lamp equal to 5% of the lamp's selling price, but never more than $1.92. The store's profit on a lamp is its selling price minus the store's cost and the commission. The store lowers the lamp's selling price by 10%. By what percent must the number of lamps sold increase so that the store's total profit from lamps stays the same, to the nearest tenth of a percent?

prompt: A sample of a radioactive substance has a mass of 4,000 milligrams when it is first measured. Its mass decreases by 20% every 6 hours. To the nearest milligram, how many milligrams of the substance decay between 6 hours and 18 hours after the first measurement?

On one trip, a delivery van was driven 140 miles in city traffic, where it averaged 14 miles per gallon of gasoline, and 360 miles on highways, where it averaged 24 miles per gallon. Gasoline cost $3.90 per gallon. To the nearest tenth of a cent, what was the van's gasoline cost per mile, in cents, for the whole trip?

Ana's value of x is how much greater than the x-value of the solution of the original system?

Triangle PQR has a right angle at vertex R, so side PQ is the hypotenuse, side QR is opposite angle P, and side PR is adjacent to angle P. The value of sin P is 8/17, and the perimeter of triangle PQR is 120 centimeters. To the nearest centimeter, what is the length of side PR?
